motion_system: Keep the plate still at rest. Only activation of the single reflective aperture shifts a short glass highlight and clears a small trace of smoke; retain a still-state fallback and leave every other fragment stationary.
color_drift: None. Hold gray-blue, deep black and peach-copper steady, with white punctures and tiny embedded green-violet grains.
glow_behavior: No emissive glow or halos; highlights behave as brief, hard reflections confined to existing glass and plastic edges.
